claims.text: The dataset was created by contributors recording voice clips from a bank of donated sentences, with each clip validated by at least two other users.
Most sentences in the dataset are covered by multiple speakers, ensuring diversity in gender, age, and accents.
Samples exceeding 3,000 frames or 256 characters were removed for efficiency, with minimal impact on the dataset size.
